items.title_en: Wayanad gears up for week-long Onam celebrations
items.title_hi: Wayanad gears up for week-long Onam celebrations
items.detail_en: Programmes will be held at tourist destinations across the district until August 30. Events include ‘Climb with Maveli’, a mega floral carpet, tug-of-war, kayaking, Kaikottikali, Thiruvathira and mud football competitions.
